mentions.name: The Resume Chef
mentions.description: A free, private resume builder with 10 templates to get started. Résumés can be exported as a PDF or stored on Google Drive or Dropbox in JSON format, with no paywalls or monthly subscriptions. Online payments via Stripe are planned but pending the author's Dutch KvK number.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of always having to update their wife's and family members' résumés.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I got tired of always having to update my wife, and my family members résumés. So I created https://theresumechef.com 
It's private,free to use, no pay walls or monthly subscriptions.It has10 resume templates to choose from to get you started.The final resume can be exported as a PDF, or stored on Google Drive or Dropbox in JSON format.
mentions.author: nexawave-ai
